Embedding request with encoding_format base64 decodes to a float array embedding

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import EmbeddingRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = EmbeddingRequest.from_json("{\"encoding_format\":\"base64\",\"input\":\"Test input\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
    result = await client.embed(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
